Loops.Draft.mk.injEq.states: ∀ (label : Option String) (env : Loops.Env) (salt : List UInt8) (payload : Loops.Json) (label_1 : Option String) (env_1 : Loops.Env) (salt_1 : List UInt8) (payload_1 : Loops.Json), ({ label := label, env := env, salt := salt, payload := payload } = { label := label_1, env := env_1, salt := salt_1, payload := payload_1 }) = (label = label_1 ∧ env = env_1 ∧ salt = salt_1 ∧ payload = payload_1)

Loops.Draft.mk.inj.states: ∀ {label : Option String} {env : Loops.Env} {salt : List UInt8} {payload : Loops.Json} {label_1 : Option String} {env_1 : Loops.Env} {salt_1 : List UInt8} {payload_1 : Loops.Json}, { label := label, env := env, salt := salt, payload := payload } = { label := label_1, env := env_1, salt := salt_1, payload := payload_1 } → label = label_1 ∧ env = env_1 ∧ salt = salt_1 ∧ payload = payload_1

Loops.Count.repeats.states: ∀ (xs : List Loops.Record), Loops.Count.fold 0 (xs ++ xs) = 2 * Loops.Count.fold 0 xs

Loops.Count.perm.states: ∀ {xs ys : List Loops.Record}, xs.Perm ys → ∀ (n : Nat), Loops.Count.fold n xs = Loops.Count.fold n ys

Loops.Count.fold_eq.states: ∀ (n : Nat) (xs : List Loops.Record), Loops.Count.fold n xs = n + xs.length

Loops.Count.batch.states: ∀ (n : Nat) (xs ys : List Loops.Record), Loops.Count.fold (Loops.Count.fold n xs) ys = Loops.Count.fold n (xs ++ ys)

Loops.Count.acc_fold.states: ∀ (xs : List Loops.Record), Loops.Count.acc.fold xs = Loops.Count.fold 0 xs

Loops.Cond.time_meaning.states: ∀ {f : Loops.EnvField}, f.type = Loops.FieldType.time → ∀ (op : Loops.Op) {r r' : Loops.Record}, Option.map (fun x => x.span) r.occurred = Option.map (fun x => x.span) r'.occurred → r.emitted.moment = r'.emitted.moment → { field := Loops.Field.env f, op := op }.eval r = { field := Loops.Field.env f, op := op }.eval r'

Loops.Cond.text_is.states: ∀ (t : String) (r : Loops.Record), { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.kind, op := Loops.Op.is (Loops.Arg.val (Loops.Val.str t)) }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool (t == r.kind) ∧ { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.observer, op := Loops.Op.is (Loops.Arg.val (Loops.Val.str t)) }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool (t == r.observer)

Loops.Cond.set_present.states: ∀ (r : Loops.Record), { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.about, op := Loops.Op.present }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool !r.about.isEmpty ∧ { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.prev, op := Loops.Op.present }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool !r.prev.isEmpty ∧ { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.under, op := Loops.Op.present }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool r.under.isSome ∧ { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.erases, op := Loops.Op.present }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool !r.erases.isEmpty

Loops.Cond.occurred_missing.states: ∀ (a : Loops.Arg) {r : Loops.Record}, r.occurred = none → { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.occurred, op := Loops.Op.atLeast a }.eval r = Loops.Tri.no ∧ { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.occurred, op := Loops.Op.below a }.eval r = Loops.Tri.no

Loops.Cond.occurred_is.states: ∀ (c : Loops.Claim) (r : Loops.Record), { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.occurred, op := Loops.Op.is (Loops.Arg.time c) }.eval r = Loops.Tri.yes ↔ ∃ k, r.occurred = some k ∧ k.span = c.span

Loops.Cond.occurred_below.states: ∀ (c : Loops.Claim) (r : Loops.Record), { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.occurred, op := Loops.Op.below (Loops.Arg.time c) }.eval r = Loops.Tri.yes ↔ ∃ k, r.occurred = some k ∧ k.span.start < c.span.start

Loops.Cond.occurred_atLeast.states: ∀ (c : Loops.Claim) (r : Loops.Record), { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.occurred, op := Loops.Op.atLeast (Loops.Arg.time c) }.eval r = Loops.Tri.yes ↔ ∃ k, r.occurred = some k ∧ c.span.start ≤ k.span.start

Loops.Cond.mk.sizeOf_spec.states: ∀ (field : Loops.Field) (op : Loops.Op), sizeOf { field := field, op := op } = 1 + sizeOf field + sizeOf op

Loops.Cond.mk.injEq.states: ∀ (field : Loops.Field) (op : Loops.Op) (field_1 : Loops.Field) (op_1 : Loops.Op), ({ field := field, op := op } = { field := field_1, op := op_1 }) = (field = field_1 ∧ op = op_1)

Loops.Cond.mk.inj.states: ∀ {field : Loops.Field} {op : Loops.Op} {field_1 : Loops.Field} {op_1 : Loops.Op}, { field := field, op := op } = { field := field_1, op := op_1 } → field = field_1 ∧ op = op_1

Loops.Cond.id_is.states: ∀ (i : String) (r : Loops.Record), { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.prev, op := Loops.Op.is (Loops.Arg.val (Loops.Val.str i)) }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool ((List.map Loops.idText r.prev).contains i) ∧ { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.under, op := Loops.Op.is (Loops.Arg.val (Loops.Val.str i)) }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool ((List.map Loops.idText r.under.toList).contains i) ∧ { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.erases, op := Loops.Op.is (Loops.Arg.val (Loops.Val.str i)) }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool ((List.map Loops.idText r.erases).contains i)

Loops.Cond.eval_view.states: ∀ {f : Loops.Record → Loops.Record}, Loops.View f → ∀ (c : Loops.Cond) (r : Loops.Record), (c.eval (f r)).Refines (c.eval r)

Loops.Cond.eval_here.states: ∀ (c : Loops.Cond) {r : Loops.Record}, r.shown = Loops.Shown.here → c.eval r ≠ Loops.Tri.unknown

Loops.Cond.eval_envelope.states: ∀ (c : Loops.Cond), c.field.onEnvelope = true → ∀ (r : Loops.Record), c.eval r ≠ Loops.Tri.unknown

Loops.Cond.emitted_is.states: ∀ (c : Loops.Claim) (r : Loops.Record), { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.emitted, op := Loops.Op.is (Loops.Arg.time c) }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool (c.span == Loops.Span.point r.emitted.moment)

Loops.Cond.emitted_below.states: ∀ (c : Loops.Claim) (r : Loops.Record), { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.emitted, op := Loops.Op.below (Loops.Arg.time c) }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool (decide (r.emitted.moment < c.span.start))

Loops.Cond.emitted_atLeast.states: ∀ (c : Loops.Claim) (r : Loops.Record), { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.emitted, op := Loops.Op.atLeast (Loops.Arg.time c) }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool (decide (c.span.start ≤ r.emitted.moment))

Loops.Cond.all_view.states: ∀ {f : Loops.Record → Loops.Record}, Loops.View f → ∀ (cs : List Loops.Cond) (r : Loops.Record), (Loops.Cond.all cs (f r)).Refines (Loops.Cond.all cs r)

Loops.Cond.all_perm.states: ∀ {cs ds : List Loops.Cond}, cs.Perm ds → ∀ (r : Loops.Record), Loops.Cond.all cs r = Loops.Cond.all ds r

Loops.Cond.all_eq_yes.states: ∀ {cs : List Loops.Cond} {r : Loops.Record}, Loops.Cond.all cs r = Loops.Tri.yes ↔ ∀ (c : Loops.Cond), c ∈ cs → c.eval r = Loops.Tri.yes

Loops.Cond.all_envelope_view.states: ∀ {f : Loops.Record → Loops.Record}, Loops.View f → ∀ {cs : List Loops.Cond}, (∀ (c : Loops.Cond), c ∈ cs → c.field.onEnvelope = true) → ∀ (r : Loops.Record), Loops.Cond.all cs (f r) = Loops.Cond.all cs r

Loops.Cond.about_is.states: ∀ (t : String) (r : Loops.Record), { field := Loops.Field.env Loops.EnvField.about, op := Loops.Op.is (Loops.Arg.val (Loops.Val.str t)) }.eval r = Loops.Tri.ofBool (r.about.contains t)

Loops.Claim.mk.sizeOf_spec.states: ∀ (text : String) (span : Loops.Span) (ok : Loops.occurredSpan? text = some span), sizeOf { text := text, span := span, ok := ok } = 1 + sizeOf text + sizeOf span + sizeOf ok

Loops.Claim.mk.injEq.states: ∀ (text : String) (span : Loops.Span) (ok : Loops.occurredSpan? text = some span) (text_1 : String) (span_1 : Loops.Span) (ok_1 : Loops.occurredSpan? text_1 = some span_1), ({ text := text, span := span, ok := ok } = { text := text_1, span := span_1, ok := ok_1 }) = (text = text_1 ∧ span = span_1)

Loops.Claim.mk.inj.states: ∀ {text : String} {span : Loops.Span} {ok : Loops.occurredSpan? text = some span} {text_1 : String} {span_1 : Loops.Span} {ok_1 : Loops.occurredSpan? text_1 = some span_1}, { text := text, span := span, ok := ok } = { text := text_1, span := span_1, ok := ok_1 } → text = text_1 ∧ span = span_1

Loops.Acc.select_set_decides.states: ∀ {σ : Type} (f : Loops.Acc σ) (ev : Loops.Record → Loops.Tri) {xs ys : List Loops.Record}, Loops.Distinct xs → Loops.Distinct ys → (∀ (r : Loops.Record), r ∈ xs ↔ r ∈ ys) → f.select ev xs = f.select ev ys

Loops.Acc.select_here.states: ∀ {σ : Type} (f : Loops.Acc σ) (w : Loops.Where) {xs : List Loops.Record}, (∀ (r : Loops.Record), r ∈ xs → r.shown = Loops.Shown.here) → (∀ (r : Loops.Record), r ∈ xs → f.readable r = true) → f.select w.eval xs = { value := f.fold (List.filter (fun x => w.eval x == Loops.Tri.yes) xs), unread := 0 }

Loops.Acc.mk.injEq.states: ∀ {σ : Type} (init : σ) (step : σ → Loops.Record → σ) (comm : ∀ (s : σ) (a b : Loops.Record), step (step s a) b = step (step s b) a) (readable : Loops.Record → Bool) (init_1 : σ) (step_1 : σ → Loops.Record → σ) (comm_1 : ∀ (s : σ) (a b : Loops.Record), step_1 (step_1 s a) b = step_1 (step_1 s b) a) (readable_1 : Loops.Record → Bool), ({ init := init, step := step, comm := comm, readable := readable } = { init := init_1, step := step_1, comm := comm_1, readable := readable_1 }) = (init = init_1 ∧ step = step_1 ∧ readable = readable_1)

Loops.Acc.mk.inj.states: ∀ {σ : Type} {init : σ} {step : σ → Loops.Record → σ} {comm : ∀ (s : σ) (a b : Loops.Record), step (step s a) b = step (step s b) a} {readable : Loops.Record → Bool} {init_1 : σ} {step_1 : σ → Loops.Record → σ} {comm_1 : ∀ (s : σ) (a b : Loops.Record), step_1 (step_1 s a) b = step_1 (step_1 s b) a} {readable_1 : Loops.Record → Bool}, { init := init, step := step, comm := comm, readable := readable } = { init := init_1, step := step_1, comm := comm_1, readable := readable_1 } → init = init_1 ∧ step = step_1 ∧ readable = readable_1
